About us

Comfort, safety and excellence, at every step

At VASK Transfer Services we specialise in luxury transfers to every destination, with premium sedans, vans and minibuses. We offer private tourist services and VIP security services, delivered by experienced and professional staff.

Whether it is a city transfer, an excursion or a discreet VIP experience, VASK makes sure of comfort, safety and excellence every step of the way.

Services

Six ways to travel with us

  1. To and from the airport, Piraeus port, the city and the coast of Attica.

  3. City tours and day trips, at your own pace.

  4. Transfers for meetings, conferences and corporate events.

  6. From Athens to places such as Delphi, Meteora and Nafplio.

Fantastic Experience – Private Tour & Airport Transfer

We used Vask Transfer for a private 6-hour tour of Athens and a separate airport transfer the next day. Everything was top-notch. Our driver, Vassili, was professional, friendly, and full of great local insights. He had cold water waiting for us, and the van was clean, spacious, and very comfortable for our family of four.

The tour was relaxed and flexible—we saw all the major sights at our own pace. The next day, Vassili arrived right on time for our airport transfer, making our departure stress-free. We highly recommend Vask Transfer for a smooth, personalized, and family-friendly experience in Athens.

Προτείνουμε ανεπιφύλακτα τη Vask Transfer για μια ομαλή, προσωπική και φιλική προς τις οικογένειες εμπειρία στην Αθήνα.

Booking
+30 697 714 2166 · info@vask.gr
How do I book a ride?
By phone on +30 697 714 2166, by e-mail at info@vask.gr, or with the booking form on this page, which opens a ready message for WhatsApp, Viber or e-mail. We confirm the time, meeting point, vehicle and price.
Do you work at night?
Yes. We work 24 hours a day, 7 days a week — for early flights, late ferries and Night Athens.
Where do you pick up from?
To and from Athens Airport (El. Venizelos), Piraeus port, central Athens, hotels and the coast of Attica — and any other point you tell us.
Which vehicles do you have?
Premium sedans, vans and minibuses, clean and well kept. Tell us how many you are and how much luggage you have, and we suggest the right one.
Are there hidden charges?
No. Our prices are clear and you know them before the ride.
Do you do trips outside Athens?
Yes: day trips and multi-day trips from Athens, such as Sounion, Delphi, Meteora and Nafplio, with your own driver.
Which languages do you speak?
Greek, English and German.
What time should I book for my flight or ferry?
Write the flight or ferry time in the form and we suggest the right pick-up time for you, depending on traffic.
